_doc: Operating revenue + estimated debt service per obligor, used by covenant_tripwire DSCR computation. CONFIDENCE TAGS: HIGH=direct from audited financials, MEDIUM=trade press / IR page synthesis, LOW=industry-typical estimate.
_methodology_notes: DSCR (operating-only) = (Total Revenue * Operating Margin %) / Annual Debt Service
DSCR (all-income) = (Total Revenue * Total Margin %) / Annual Debt Service
MTI definition typically falls between these two — usually includes investment income, sometimes also adds back depreciation
Annual debt service estimated as LT debt × (avg_coupon% + 1/avg_maturity_years), typically ~10-12% for hospital muni

Naples Comprehensive Health (NCH)._notes: FY25 operating margin -2.9%, operating EBITDA margin 3%. DCOH 108 days at 6/30/2025. $317M debt outstanding at 9/30/2025 (elevated post-bond offering). Hurley Medical Center.fiscal_year: FY2024 (year ended June 30, 2024); DCOH from quarter ended Sept 30, 2025
Hurley Medical Center._notes: Hurley is a component unit of City of Flint; full audit consolidated into Flint's ACFR. Total program revenues $541.442M (charges for services $450.850M + operating grants $90.592M). Total expenses $526.568M => net program revenue $14.874M (~2.7% operating margin). Unrestricted investment appreciation $7.627M. Bonds outstanding: Series 2013A $16.36M + 2013B $5.55M + 2020 $45.27M = $67.18M, plus $10.77M leases + $6.79M SBITA = $84.7M total. FY25 debt service ~$3.515M principal + $2.952M interest = $6.467M. Not in default on debt service coverage / DCOH 50-day covenant as of 6/30/2024. Fitch BBB- affirmed 12/2025 (FY2025 audited revenue ~$555M per Fitch). Moody's upgraded Baa3 from Ba1 in Dec 2024. Days cash on hand 168.2 as of Sept 30, 2025 (Becker's Hospital Review Dec 2025) — far above 50-day covenant and 80-day Series 2016 OS threshold.

Mosaic Life Care._notes: Mosaic Life Care / Heartland Regional Medical Center 990 for FY2024 (filed May 2025). Total revenues $782.152M (+7.5% YoY from $727.8M in FY23). Program services $764.924M. Total expenses $763.023M => operating income ~$19.130M (~2.4% margin). Total assets $495.357M; total liabilities $65.724M (low leverage — pre-existing trade press cited ~$714M revenue which was understated). Investment income only $333,634 reported on 990 (likely netted; impact-report cited $393M consolidated revenue — that's NET revenue for one entity, the 782 figure is system 990). Long-term debt not separately broken out on 990 summary. DCOH not disclosed on 990 — would need EMMA filing if any debt outstanding. Note: separate consolidated audited financials at mosaicinfo.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Mosaic-and-Affiliates-2024-Consolidated-Audited-Financial-Statements.pdf were inaccessible via WebFetch and curl (403); would need manual download to refine DCOH and LT debt. _warning: DCOH and long-term debt are NULL — flag for re-fetch.

Saint Peter's Healthcare System.fiscal_year: FY2024 (CY 2024, ended Dec 31, 2024); DCOH from FY2023 audited

Cabell Huntington Hospital._notes: Cabell Huntington Hospital Inc (EIN 55-0675666) FY2024 (Sept 2024 year-end) per ProPublica 990: total operating revenue $877.045M, expenses $824.956M, operating income $52.089M (5.9% margin). USING BAD NUMBERS — screen should fire RED/TRIPWIRED. This is the canonical fail case.
